entries.text: Beloit Memorial High School standout, Beloit, Wisconsin.
Wisconsin State League Rookie of the Year, Janesville Aces.
NJCAA Second Team All-American outfielder, Indian Hills Community College. 19 home runs, tied for the school's single-season top five.
Center fielder, Troy State (NCAA Division I). 71 runs scored, fifth-most in a single season in Troy history (as of 2018).
Inducted into the Troy Trojans Baseball Hall of Fame, Class of 2007 (outfield, 1999).
Drafted by the Arizona Diamondbacks, 26th round. Hit .330 in his first pro summer (Missoula, South Bend).
Hit .361 / .414 / .627 at High-A Lancaster. Filed the Power Punch patent (July 2, 2001).
Double-A El Paso, Diamondbacks organization. Hit .326.
U.S. Patent 6,514,163, "Batting aid," granted Feb 4, 2003 (now expired). Double-A Tennessee, Cardinals organization.
Live the Dream ran the two-day pro camp before the 24 Hours for Africa women's game at Tucson Electric Park; its coaches worked the game. SABR lists the 127-110 final as the planned-marathon record.
Pro career: .306 over 528 games, including independent ball at Nashua (2004) and Winnipeg (2005, .317).
Kyle Murphy, drafted by the Texas Rangers, credits his swing work with Kevan in Beloit.
Founded UnyKorn LLC (Wyoming, July 1, 2026), which now operates Live the Dream Athletics and NIL33.
